text: What if you woke up a hundred times taller?
You wake up on your back in Paris.
A tourist could stand on your thumbnail.
You groan. Car alarms wail for blocks.
You weigh as much as seven Eiffel Towers.
But your bones only got ten thousand times stronger.
That's a hundred times the strain.
By lunch, your own heat cooks you.
Each breath lifts a hundred times too much.
The café across the avenue stays open.
Your heart outweighs a blue whale.
